rooms.name: Deluxe Garden Room
rooms.highlight: Hardwood floor, rain shower and a balcony over the frangipani garden
rooms.description: A calm room on the first floor with a queen bed, a writing desk and a balcony looking into the frangipani garden. The bathroom has a rain shower and locally made toiletries. Breakfast on the terrace is included.

rooms.name: Pool View Room
rooms.highlight: Ground-floor room opening straight onto the pool deck
rooms.description: A king room with a private terrace a few steps from the water, finished with a soaking tub, a coffee machine and bathrobes for the walk to the pool. Ideal for couples who want to be first in after the temples.

rooms.name: Family Suite
rooms.highlight: Two connecting rooms and a small sitting area for up to five
rooms.description: Two bedrooms joined by a sitting area, one with a king bed and one with twin singles, each with its own bathroom. The shared balcony overlooks the garden. Breakfast for the whole family is included.

rooms.name: Garden Villa (2 bedrooms)
rooms.highlight: Two-bedroom house with its own pool, kitchen and daily housekeeping
rooms.description: A single-storey house around a six-metre pool, with a king and a queen bedroom, two bathrooms, a full kitchen and a covered terrace for meals. The housekeeper lays out breakfast each morning.

rooms.name: Grand Villa (4 bedrooms)
rooms.highlight: Four en-suite bedrooms, a twelve-metre pool and a garden sala
rooms.description: A two-storey house for a family or two couples travelling together: four en-suite bedrooms, a dining room that seats ten, a twelve-metre pool and a wooden sala in the garden. A cook for dinner can be arranged a day ahead.

rooms.name: Mixed Dorm, 8 pod beds
rooms.highlight: Curtained pod with its own light, two sockets and a full-size locker
rooms.description: One bed in an eight-bed dorm of pod bunks, each with a curtain, a reading light and USB sockets. Lockers take a full backpack. The dorm has two shared bathrooms with hot water.

rooms.name: Female Dorm, 6 pod beds
rooms.highlight: Top-floor women-only dorm with its own bathroom and a quiet balcony
rooms.description: A six-bed dorm for women on the top floor, with the same pod bunks, a private bathroom with a hairdryer and a small balcony facing the river. Noticeably quieter than the floors below.

rooms.name: Private Double
rooms.highlight: A simple air-conditioned double with its own bathroom
rooms.description: A small private room with a double bed, air-conditioning and an en-suite shower, for couples who want the hostel's rooftop without the dorm. The window looks onto the quiet inner courtyard.

rooms.name: Forest Bungalow
rooms.highlight: Timber-and-thatch bungalow with a veranda over the stream
rooms.description: A stilted bungalow with a queen bed under a mosquito net, a ceiling fan, a solar-heated shower open to the trees and a veranda with two chairs over the stream. Breakfast in the sala is included.

rooms.name: Hillside Bungalow
rooms.highlight: Higher on the slope, with a plateau view and an outdoor bathtub
rooms.description: The three bungalows at the top of the slope face the escarpment of Kulen, with a king bed, a stone bathtub on the veranda and a kettle for the cold mornings. Worth the extra steps.

rooms.name: Family Lodge
rooms.highlight: Two-bedroom timber house for a family of five
rooms.description: A larger house at the end of the path with a queen bedroom, a second room of three single beds, two bathrooms and a wide veranda where the children can watch for hornbills. Breakfast for all is included.

rooms.name: Lake Room
rooms.highlight: Floor mattress for two under a net, shutters opening onto the water
rooms.description: A wooden room at the back of the house with a thick floor mattress for two, a mosquito net and shutters that open onto the lake. The bathroom is shared and downstairs. Dinner and breakfast with the family are included.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.highlight: Larger room with two mattresses, for parents and children
rooms.description: The bigger of the two rooms, with a double mattress and two singles laid side by side under nets, enough for a family of four. The same shared bathroom, the same table downstairs, the same dawn boat.

rooms.name: Deluxe River View
rooms.highlight: Floor-to-ceiling window on the Tonle Sap, king bed and marble bath
rooms.description: A forty-square-metre room on an upper floor with a king bed facing the river, a marble bathroom with a tub and a separate shower, a working desk and blackout curtains. Buffet breakfast is included.

rooms.name: Executive Suite
rooms.highlight: Separate sitting room, lounge access and evening cocktails on the top floor
rooms.description: A corner suite with a bedroom and a separate sitting room, both facing the river junction. Includes executive lounge access with breakfast, afternoon tea and evening cocktails, plus pressing and late check-out.

rooms.name: Royal Suite
rooms.highlight: Two bedrooms, a dining room for eight and a butler on call
rooms.description: The top-floor suite with two king bedrooms, a dining room, a pantry and a balcony along the river face. A butler handles unpacking, pressing and in-suite dining; airport transfers are included.

rooms.name: Fan Room
rooms.highlight: Tiled double with a ceiling fan and shutters onto the garden
rooms.description: A ground-floor room with a double bed, a ceiling fan and a hot shower, opening straight onto the garden. The cheapest and coolest room in the house once the sun is off the wall.

rooms.name: Air-con Double
rooms.highlight: Upstairs double with air-conditioning and a balcony over the street
rooms.description: An upstairs room with air-conditioning, a small fridge and a shuttered balcony onto the quiet street. There is a hot shower, a wardrobe and a television that mostly shows Khmer soaps.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.highlight: Double plus two singles, air-conditioned, with a garden balcony
rooms.description: The largest room, with a double and two single beds, air-conditioning and a balcony facing the mango trees. Fits a family of four comfortably; a fold-out bed can be added for a fifth.

rooms.name: Studio Residence
rooms.highlight: Open-plan studio with a kitchenette, a desk and a city view
rooms.description: A bright studio with a queen bed, a kitchenette with a hob and microwave, a proper desk and a window wall over the city. Housekeeping twice a week on longer stays, daily on request.

rooms.name: One-Bedroom Residence
rooms.highlight: Separate bedroom, full kitchen, washer-dryer and a river-facing balcony
rooms.description: A one-bedroom apartment with a living room, a full kitchen with oven and washer-dryer, a bathroom with tub and shower, and a balcony facing the river. The most-booked layout for stays of a week or more.

rooms.name: Two-Bedroom Sky Suite
rooms.highlight: Corner apartment on the 27th floor with two en-suites and wraparound views
rooms.description: A corner apartment one floor below the pool, with two en-suite bedrooms, a dining table for six, a long balcony on two sides and views of the river junction and the palace roofs. Suits families or colleagues sharing.

rooms.name: Weaver's Room
rooms.highlight: Upstairs room in the family house, above the looms
rooms.description: A wooden room upstairs with a double bed under a net, a fan and a window onto the mango trees. The bathroom is shared with the other two guest rooms. You wake to the sound of the shuttles below.

rooms.name: Riverside Bungalow
rooms.highlight: Private bungalow on the bank with its own bathroom and a hammock
rooms.description: A thatched bungalow at the bottom of the garden with a queen bed, a private hot shower and a veranda with a hammock facing the Mekong. Boats pass all day; at night it is just the water.

rooms.name: Pepper Garden Bungalow
rooms.highlight: Veranda facing the vines, queen bed and an outdoor shower
rooms.description: A tiled-roof bungalow at the edge of the pepper rows with a queen bed, a semi-open shower walled in local stone and a veranda with two planter's chairs. Breakfast on the restaurant terrace is included.

rooms.name: Hillside Bungalow
rooms.highlight: On the rise behind the farm, with a view to the Kep hills and a daybed
rooms.description: Four bungalows on the slope behind the farm with king beds, a bathtub by the window and a daybed on the veranda facing the hills of Kep. The quietest corner of the estate and the best for sunset.

rooms.name: Family Bungalow
rooms.highlight: Two bedrooms under one roof, with a shared veranda and kitchenette
rooms.description: A double bungalow with a queen bedroom and a twin bedroom, each with its own bathroom, joined by a sitting area with a kitchenette and a long veranda. Breakfast for the family is included.

rooms.name: Fan Double
rooms.highlight: Clean back room with a fan, hot shower and a window onto the courtyard
rooms.description: A plain double at the back of the first floor with a ceiling fan, a hot shower and a window onto the inner courtyard, away from the road. The best value in town for a bed and a rooftop.

rooms.name: Air-con Twin
rooms.highlight: Two single beds, air-conditioning and a fridge for the beer
rooms.description: A twin room on the second floor with air-conditioning, two firm single beds, a small fridge and a hot shower. It suits friends sharing or a parent travelling with one child.

rooms.name: River View Balcony Room
rooms.highlight: Front room with a balcony over the river and the Bokor ridge
rooms.description: The rooms everyone asks for: a queen bed, air-conditioning and a shuttered balcony straight over the river, with the mountain filling the view. Expect a little traffic noise in the early morning.

rooms.name: Sea Villa (3 bedrooms)
rooms.highlight: Three en-suite bedrooms, a pool on the rocks and a chef for the day
rooms.description: A single-storey house with a king, a queen and a twin bedroom, each en suite, an open kitchen and living room, and a fourteen-metre pool on the rocks above the water. Chef, housekeeper and breakfast included.

rooms.name: Grand Sea Villa (5 bedrooms)
rooms.highlight: Two floors, five bedrooms, a roof deck and a pool for ten
rooms.description: The larger house, on two floors with five en-suite bedrooms, a dining room for twelve, a roof deck for sunset and an eighteen-metre pool. The boat for Rabbit Island is included once per stay.

rooms.name: Garden Room
rooms.highlight: Timber-and-linen room with a terrace onto the garden, two minutes from the sand
rooms.description: A ground-floor room in the garden wing with a king bed, a semi-outdoor rain shower and a terrace with daybeds under the trees. The beach is a short walk through the garden. Breakfast is included.

rooms.name: Spa Suite
rooms.highlight: Upper-floor suite with a sea glimpse, a bathtub and two spa treatments included
rooms.description: A first-floor suite over the spa pavilions with a king bed, a deep tub, a sitting area and a balcony looking through the casuarinas to the sea. Two sixty-minute treatments per stay are included.

rooms.name: Beachfront Pool Villa
rooms.highlight: Private plunge pool, sala and the sand directly in front
rooms.description: One of four villas on the beach itself, with a king bedroom, an outdoor bathroom, a plunge pool and a sala for breakfast, served to the villa each morning. Nothing between the terrace and the sea but sand.

rooms.name: Sea View Bungalow
rooms.highlight: Wooden bungalow on the slope with a balcony facing the sunset
rooms.description: A timber bungalow on the slope behind the beach with a queen bed under a net, a fan, a solar-heated shower and a balcony that looks west over the water. Breakfast at the beach restaurant is included.

rooms.name: Beachfront Bungalow
rooms.highlight: Steps from the water, with a hammock on the deck and an outdoor shower
rooms.description: Six bungalows on the sand itself, with a queen bed, an outdoor shower screened by bamboo and a deck with a hammock a few steps from the water. These go first in the dry season.

rooms.name: Family Bungalow
rooms.highlight: Two rooms under one roof for a family of five, on the sand
rooms.description: A larger bungalow with a queen room and a second room of three singles, one bathroom and a wide deck facing the beach. Breakfast for everyone is included; children eat free from the kids' menu at dinner.

rooms.name: Mixed Dorm, 12 beds
rooms.highlight: Open-sided longhouse dorm with nets, fans and lockers
rooms.description: One bunk in the twelve-bed longhouse, with a mosquito net, a fan over each bunk, a locker and a shared cold-water bathroom. Shutters open to the trees; the sea is thirty metres away.

rooms.name: Mixed Dorm, 8 beds
rooms.highlight: Smaller dorm at the quiet end with its own bathroom
rooms.description: Eight bunks at the quiet end of the longhouse with their own bathroom and a little more space between the beds. Lockers, nets and fans as in the main dorm.

rooms.name: Beach Hut
rooms.highlight: Private thatched hut on the sand with a double bed and a hammock
rooms.description: A thatched hut on the beach with a double bed under a net, a fan, a basic private bathroom with cold water and a deck with a hammock. Romantic in a barefoot sort of way.

rooms.name: Heritage Double
rooms.highlight: Four-metre ceilings, original tiles and teak shutters onto the courtyard
rooms.description: A first-floor room at the back of the house with a queen bed under a high ceiling, the original 1920s tiles, teak shutters opening onto the courtyard and a modern bathroom. Breakfast in the café is included.

rooms.name: Balcony Suite
rooms.highlight: Front room with the river balcony, a sitting corner and a clawfoot tub
rooms.description: The three front rooms share the long balcony over the river road and have a king bed, a sitting corner by the shutters and a clawfoot bathtub. Evenings on the balcony with the river traffic below are the house's best feature.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.highlight: Queen and two singles under one high ceiling, with a courtyard window
rooms.description: Two rooms on the top floor with a queen bed and two singles, air-conditioning, a fridge and a window onto the courtyard. Breakfast for the family is included, and the bicycles come in children's sizes too.

rooms.name: Hillside Bungalow
rooms.highlight: Pine bungalow with a duvet, a hot shower and a veranda over the valley
rooms.description: A pine-clad bungalow with a queen bed under a thick duvet, an electric heater for December, a hot shower and a veranda facing the valley. Breakfast with highland coffee is included.

rooms.name: Valley View Lodge
rooms.highlight: Larger bungalow at the top of the slope with a bathtub and a daybed
rooms.description: The five lodges along the ridge have king beds, a bathtub facing the window, a coffee machine stocked with the local roast and a daybed on the veranda for the morning mist. The widest view on the property.

rooms.name: Family Cabin
rooms.highlight: Two-bedroom cabin with a wood stove and bunks for the children
rooms.description: A two-bedroom cabin set apart in the garden with a queen room for the parents, a bunk room for the children, a small wood stove in the sitting area and a veranda with a view down the valley. Breakfast for all included.

rooms.name: Standard Twin
rooms.highlight: Two single beds, air-conditioning, a window over the market lane
rooms.description: A clean twin room on the lower floors with air-conditioning, a hot shower, a small fridge and a window onto the lane behind the hotel. Breakfast on the river terrace is included.

rooms.name: Mekong View Double
rooms.highlight: Upper-floor double with a balcony over the river and the ferry landing
rooms.description: A queen room on the third floor with a balcony facing the river and the island, a desk under the window and the same cold air-conditioning. The sunset is yours from the balcony every evening.

rooms.name: Family River Room
rooms.highlight: Queen plus two singles on the top floor, with a wide river balcony
rooms.description: The top-floor family rooms have a queen bed, two singles and a long balcony over the Mekong, with breakfast included for everyone. Bicycles for the island are free for guests.

rooms.name: Garden Bungalow
rooms.highlight: Wooden bungalow with a fan, a hot shower and a veranda hammock
rooms.description: A simple wooden bungalow in the garden with a double bed under a net, a fan, a hot shower and a veranda with a hammock. The cashew trees drop their fruit on the roof in season.

rooms.name: Air-con Double
rooms.highlight: Room in the main block with air-conditioning and a tiled bathroom
rooms.description: An upstairs room in the main block with a queen bed, air-conditioning for the hot months, a fridge and a small balcony over the garden. The bathroom is tiled and the water is reliably hot.

rooms.name: Family Bungalow
rooms.highlight: Two-room bungalow for four with a wide veranda
rooms.description: A larger bungalow with a double room and a twin room off a shared veranda, air-conditioning in both, one bathroom and a fridge for the drinks. Good for families heading to the lake.

rooms.name: River Bungalow
rooms.highlight: Bank-side bungalow in the trees with a deck above the water
rooms.description: A thatched bungalow on the slope with a queen bed under a net, a solar-heated shower open to the trees and a deck on stilts over the water's edge. Breakfast on the floating restaurant is included.

rooms.name: Floating Bungalow
rooms.highlight: On a pontoon in the river, with a ladder straight into the water
rooms.description: The six floating bungalows rock gently on their pontoons, with a king bed, a deck with loungers and a ladder down into the river for a swim before breakfast. A kayak is tied to each one.

rooms.name: Family Bungalow
rooms.highlight: Two bedrooms on the bank, for up to five, with a shared deck
rooms.description: A larger bank-side bungalow with a queen room, a second room of three singles, two bathrooms and a long shared deck over the river. Children over six are welcome, and life jackets come with the kayaks.
